import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path.cwd()
for n,pat in [('1204.4010',r'Conjecture 5\.1|m ⩾ 5|m ≥ 5'),('1307.0124',r'Conjecture 3\.|\(p − 1\)\(q − 1\)|conjecture was proved'),('1309.0680',r'coNP|co-NP'),('1405.5558',r'extD \(S|Conjecture 1|Conjecture 3'),('1409.3503',r'3/2|3 W|points.lines|Points.Lines'),('1401.0500',r'inequality.*is|Definition 3\.1'),('2410.19076',r'Conjecture|Proof of Theorem 8|coloring constraints')]:
 t=(p/'sources'/(n+'.txt')).read_text().splitlines();print('FILE',n)
 hits=[j for j,l in enumerate(t) if re.search(pat,l,re.I)]
 for j in hits[:3]:print('\n'.join(f'{k+1}: {t[k]}' for k in range(max(0,j-7),min(len(t),j+25))))
